persons.name: Jagannātha
persons.evidence: likhitamidam, śalhyā nārājadhānyāṃ ḍāḍāgrāme svastiśrī --------------------------------- sadāsamara vijayināmājñayā śrī jagannātha śarmma

date.as_written: śrīśāke 1729 śrī vikramārka saṃvati 1864 kārttike kṛṣṇe pratipadatithau śanivāsare

notes: The manuscript was copied by order of a ruler/patron whose name is lost in the lacuna (svastiśrī --------------------------------- sadāsamara vijayināmājñayā). Both Śaka era 1729 and Vikrama Saṃvat 1864 are given.
